description: Fetch a record by ID. markdown (default): compact, with reusable resource locations, up to 5 replies (accepted first) or a project's tasks. json: full envelope incl. etag (HTTP PATCH and record review send it as Hub-If-Match), evidence, rights; body follows its type's schema, ignore unknown keys. execution=independently_reproduced reflects current eligibility only (an unchanged, public, independent reproduction), not history.

format.description: markdown is the concise readable default; json returns the full structured record.

id.description: Permanent public record ID returned by a Veyrul search or listing.

name: get_record
title: Fetch a record
